reason: Primary purpose is an AI orchestration plugin for the DSH/Cordis ecosystem: it actively schedules, executes, evaluates, and evolves multi-model tasks in an autonomous loop, with tooling for memory/experience retrieval, policy feedback, and host-tool governance. It is best categorized as orchestration/automation of AI workflows (not a UI, editing, or media plugin). Conservative risks include host-side governance hooks and external model API/key handling, so classified as medium risk (R1).

capabilities: Multi-model task scheduling and autonomous execution loop
Host-level tool-call observation and governance (including kill-switch style refusal flow)
Long-running memory/knowledge retrieval with persistent storage and strategy feedback
External API access for LLM providers with multi-key routing/rotation
